scope: Local native ComfyUI Pixal3D/TRELLIS2 candidate generation and Blender projection trial. This record is evidence for a draft, not a production approval.

native_generation.server: ComfyUI isolated loopback http://127.0.0.1:8197; --disable-all-custom-nodes --disable-api-nodes --disable-auto-launch --lowvram --reserve-vram 0.5; D: input/output/temp/user directories
native_generation.geometry: Pixal3D 512 route: VaeDecodeStructureTrellis2 resolution 32; 1536 cascade bypassed; remesh resolution 512 then DecimateMesh target 200000 midpoint.
native_generation.sampling: shape sampler seed 42, 20 Euler/normal steps, CFG 7.5; texture sampler seed 43, 12 Euler/normal steps, CFG 1; auxiliary sampler seed 56, 12 Euler/normal steps, CFG 7.5.
native_generation.body_multiview: front/back only; FOV 20; CropToMask 1024 square, alpha-aware black background, pad 1.1; 2048 texture atlas, 196262 faces/3152 charts, packed atlas 2130x2132.
native_generation.single_head: front crop x=260,y=0,w=520,h=500; CropToMask 1024 RGB sRGB, alpha-aware black background, pad 1.05; FOV 20; 2048 texture atlas, 198518 faces/3699 charts, packed atlas 2146x2151.
native_generation.head_multiview_reference: front/left/back exact crops; screen-left-facing side source correctly maps to native left=+90 degrees (front=0, back=180); never mirrored. Its GLB is preserved but not selected.

projection.camera: canonical C=(0,-3.1192050007897403,0), forward +Y, right +X, up +Z, FOV 20 degrees; v is Blender UV bottom-origin
projection.parameters: uv-scale=1, offset-u=0, offset-v=0, strength=1; UV_PROJ_FRONT and POINT FaceProjectionWeight; source image packed; original PBR base-color branch preserved and mixed only inside face/neck ellipses.

runtime_and_network.network: public unauthenticated model downloads only; no user-art upload, cloud inference, paid service, or API key used

known_fidelity_failures: Bangs/fringe still obscure eyes in three-quarter views.
Generated texture/UV baking can contain duplicate or blurred facial details; projection improves only the bounded front face/neck region.
Hands/fingers from the body candidate remain fused or otherwise unsuitable for rigging.
Coat/cardigan and rear-bag/accessory fidelity remains inferred and may differ from source views.
This is generated topology and unrigged draft geometry; no production, retopology, seam, or rig approval is implied.
